Specification: This module specifies a simple asynchronous sender-receiver interface using a handshake between the variables rdy and ack, with val carrying data from the set Data. The sender may perform Send only when rdy = ack, at which point it chooses a new value for val and toggles rdy; the receiver may perform Rcv only when rdy # ack, at which point it toggles ack and leaves val and rdy unchanged. The specification defines an initial state, a next-state relation, and a temporal specification requiring all behaviors to start in Init and then follow Next with stuttering allowed; it also states a theorem that Spec implies the invariant TypeInvariant always holds.
